control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, then if LEFT sees an obstacle turn left 20°, else if RIGHT sees an obstacle turn right 20°, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 % without end; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT sees an obstacle, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Get through a bending dark tunnel without touching it by turning away from its walls: right for a wall on the left, left for a wall on the right.

branches.outcome: LEFT sees a wall: the robot turns left 20°

the line tracker sees no black: the robot curves right
